title: 河岸生態護岸~Bioengineered riverbank protection
focus: 以水流荷載、活體建立與河岸監測共同設計護岸~Designing bank protection through hydraulic loads, plant establishment and monitoring
summary: 由趾部沖刷、木構浮力到根系補強與季節存活，逐一拆開生態護岸的承載機制。課程要求先辨認河道變遷與植物適生條件，再安排材料、施工窗口與後續監測，以對照組觀察功能是否形成，而不把綠色外觀當成安全證明。~Separate the load paths of toe protection, buoyant wood, root reinforcement and seasonal plant establishment. Identify channel adjustment and vegetation suitability before selecting materials, construction windows and monitoring. Use comparison sites to examine whether the intended functions actually develop instead of treating a green bank as evidence of structural performance.
history: 美國自然資源保育署二〇〇七年河岸土壤生物工程補編，將河趾、岸坡與洪氾平原的處理方式分開討論，並收錄佛蒙特州威努斯基河背景。二〇二〇年國家層級護岸標準目錄另提醒實作須依地方文件。雷赫河一九九八年啟動的復育計畫則提供河川動態與棲地共存的尺度參照。本課不聲稱這些案例採用相同工法，所有荷載及材料數字均為獨立教材假設。~The 2007 NRCS soil bioengineering supplement distinguishes treatments at the toe, bank and floodplain and includes Winooski River context in Vermont. The 2020 national bank protection directory directs actual application to local documents. The Regge programme launched in 1998 offers a broader example of accommodating river dynamics and habitat. These references do not imply identical construction methods. All loads and material quantities in the exercises are independently chosen teaching assumptions.
example: 本課先用「河岸剪力的尺度」建立原創假想基準，再以「植生莖叢的阻力」檢查另一個控制機制。第一組輸入及結果為 rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa；第二組為 rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N。學員需在同一張工作表分列量綱、時間、位置與適用範圍，先核對守恆，再解釋為何兩個得數不能互相代替。最後以第三單元提出的量測設計驗證假設，並將超出模型能力的水理、生態或治理問題列為待研究項目；這些示例並非所列案例的現場實測。敏感度重算：固定 rho=1000 kg/m3、g=9.81 m/s2 與 S=0.003 無因次，只將 R 從 0.8 m 增至 0.88 m，tau=25.8984 Pa，相較 23.544 Pa 增加一成。這仍是河段平均，不能當外彎局部最大值。~Begin with an original hypothetical baseline for Scales of bank shear and examine another controlling mechanism through Drag on vegetation stems. The first inputs and result are rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa; the second are rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N. Keep dimensions, time, location and validity conditions in separate columns of the same working sheet. Check conservation before explaining why the two numerical results cannot substitute for one another. Use the third unit measurement design to test assumptions and identify hydraulic, ecological or governance questions that exceed the model. These examples are not field observations from the named reference cases. Sensitivity recalculation: Keep rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2 and dimensionless S=0.003 fixed, changing only R from 0.8 m to 0.88 m. The stress becomes 25.8984 Pa, ten percent above 23.544 Pa. It remains a reach average rather than the outer-bank local maximum.

units.anchor: 河岸剪力的尺度~Scales of bank shear
units.title: 河岸剪力的尺度~Scales of bank shear
units.mechanism: 河岸植生先面對水流造成的剪力與局部紊流，再由莖葉、根系及土體共同承受。斷面平均水力半徑乘以能坡只能估算河段平均床面剪力，彎道外岸、橋墩附近與淹沒植物間可能有完全不同的局部荷載。選工法前應把深槽、主流線和沖刷痕跡畫在同一張圖，辨認保護對象是表土、岸趾或整個滑動體，才決定平均量是否足以篩選材料。~Vegetation encounters flow shear and turbulence before stems, roots and soil share the resulting loads. Hydraulic radius and energy slope give a reach averaged boundary stress, while bends, obstructions and submerged plants can produce very different local loads. Map the thalweg, main current and erosion traces together. Identify whether protection targets surface soil, the toe or an entire sliding mass before deciding whether an average stress can screen a treatment.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa。適用邊界：假設定常近均勻流，結果是平均邊界剪力，不是外彎岸坡最大剪力或植物耐受值。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa. Applicable boundary: Assumes steady approximately uniform flow; the result is average boundary stress, not maximum outer-bank stress or plant resistance.
units.verify: 在同一水位下量測斷面與水面坡度，並以多點流速確認主流位置。分別記錄裸岸、草叢與岸趾附近的沖刷，若局部集中而平均剪力不高，應增加局部水理分析，不能只提高一個平均係數。~Survey cross sections and water surface slope at the same stage, and locate the current with multiple velocity measurements. Record erosion near bare soil, vegetation and the toe separately. Concentrated erosion despite modest average stress requires local hydraulic investigation.
units.failure: 彎道近岸高速帶可能掏空根區，使表面完整的植生毯失去支承。診斷須追查水下岸趾與局部流向，而非先把植株死亡判成養護不足。~A near-bank jet can undermine roots while the surface mat still appears intact. Investigate the submerged toe and current direction before attributing plant loss to poor maintenance alone.
units.misconception: 河段平均剪力就是每一處岸坡承受的最大剪力~Reach average shear is the maximum stress at every bank location
units.practice: 改以能坡增加一半重算平均剪力，再繪製兩個具有相同平均值但主流位置不同的斷面，說明哪一種情況需要增加岸趾量測，並列出判讀依據。~Increase energy slope by half and recompute average shear. Sketch two sections with equal averages but different current positions, then explain which requires additional toe measurements and what observations would justify that decision.

units.anchor: 植生莖叢的阻力~Drag on vegetation stems
units.title: 植生莖叢的阻力~Drag on vegetation stems
units.mechanism: 植物在水中既增加粗糙度，也把水流動量轉成莖幹與根盤的荷載。迎流面積不是種植面積，而是投影在垂直流向平面的有效面積；柔軟植株彎伏後，面積與阻力係數會隨流速改變。群生植物還會彼此遮蔽或集中水流，因此單株試驗不能簡單乘株數。設計時應區分柔性變形、折斷和連根拔起三條失效路徑，並保留季節葉量不同的工況。~Vegetation adds roughness while transferring flow momentum into stems and roots. Frontal area is projected perpendicular to the current, not planted ground area. Flexible plants reconfigure, changing both area and drag coefficient as velocity increases. Neighbouring stems can shelter one another or concentrate flow, so multiplying an isolated plant test by stem count is unreliable. Distinguish bending, stem breakage and root pullout, and retain seasonal changes in foliage as separate loading conditions.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N。適用邊界：固定投影面積與阻力係數的準定常示例，未模擬彎伏、波動或群生效應。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N. Applicable boundary: A quasi-steady example with fixed projected area and drag coefficient, excluding reconfiguration, fluctuations and group effects.
units.verify: 以可量測拉力的小型枝條模型比較直立與彎伏狀態，逐級提高流速並拍攝迎流面積。把力除以速度平方後查看是否仍接近常數，若偏離便追查形狀改變，勿先當成儀器漂移。~Measure force on a small branch model in upright and bent states while increasing velocity gradually. Photograph the projected area. Examine force divided by velocity squared; changes may indicate reconfiguration rather than unexplained electronic sensor drift.
units.failure: 洪水夾帶雜物會擴大有效迎流面積，使原先按清潔枝條估算的根部荷載偏低。若只清點折枝而未查根盤位移，會漏掉尚未倒伏的損傷。~Debris can enlarge frontal area and make clean-stem calculations underestimate root loading. Counting broken branches without checking root plate movement can miss damage in plants that remain standing.
units.misconception: 種植面積可以直接代替所有莖葉的迎流投影面積~Planted ground area directly equals the frontal area of all stems
units.practice: 將流速增加百分之二十五並保持面積不變重算，再提出一個彎伏後面積縮小的對照案例，說明為何兩者的阻力增幅不同，以及所需影像資料。~Increase velocity by twenty five percent at fixed area, then construct a comparison with reduced area after bending. Explain the different force changes and identify the imagery needed to distinguish these cases.

units.anchor: 根系補強的有效面積~Effective area in root reinforcement
units.title: 根系補強的有效面積~Effective area in root reinforcement
units.mechanism: 根系穿越潛在剪動面時可提供拉力，但這個貢獻取決於根徑、方向、錨定長度與含水狀態。把根拉力除以土體剪動面積只能得到等效的附加抗剪應力，不能當成整體土壤永久增加的黏聚力。部分根會先滑出或腐朽，另一些根尚未受力，因此同步動員的有效拉力必須由試驗支持。模型應清楚標示剪動面位置，避免把表層密根區的數據套到較深的滑動面。~Roots crossing a potential shear surface can mobilize tension, depending on diameter, orientation, anchorage and moisture. Dividing effective root force by soil shear area gives an equivalent stress contribution, not a permanent increase in intrinsic soil cohesion. Some roots pull out or decay before others engage, so simultaneous mobilization requires evidence. Locate the assumed shear surface explicitly, rather than transferring measurements from a shallow dense root layer to a deeper failure plane.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Tr=1600 N; As=0.2 m2; dc=Tr/As/1000=8 kPa。適用邊界：有效拉力已假設包含方向與動員折減，僅代表指定剪面之附加應力。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Tr=1600 N; As=0.2 m2; dc=Tr/As/1000=8 kPa. Applicable boundary: Effective tension already includes assumed orientation and mobilization reductions; the result applies only to the specified shear surface.
units.verify: 對不同根徑做拉拔試驗，同時記錄斷裂或滑出模式，再量測剪動面上的根截面分布。將單根強度與整體土樣剪切結果交叉比較，確認是否真的能同時動員，並保存含水率與植物生長期。~Test pullout across root diameters and record breakage versus slippage. Map roots across the proposed shear plane. Compare individual strength with rooted soil shear tests to assess simultaneous mobilization, retaining measured soil moisture and seasonal growth stage records.
units.failure: 若實際滑動面位於根層下方，即使表層根系茂密也可能整塊滑落。應先查滑面深度與排水條件，而不是繼續增加表層播種密度。~A slide beneath the root zone can remove a densely vegetated surface as one block. Investigate slip depth and drainage before prescribing more seed or greater surface planting density.
units.misconception: 表層根系密度可直接代表任何深度滑動面的補強能力~Surface root density directly represents reinforcement on a failure plane at any depth
units.practice: 將有效拉力降低四分之一重算，並畫出穿根與不穿根的兩個滑面。為每個滑面列出必須取得的試驗資料，說明等效應力何時應取零。~Reduce effective tension by one quarter and recalculate. Draw failure planes crossing and bypassing roots, list the necessary evidence for each, and explain when the equivalent root contribution must be set to zero.

units.anchor: 木構護岸的浮力~Buoyancy of wood revetments
units.title: 木構護岸的浮力~Buoyancy of wood revetments
units.mechanism: 河岸枯木或根盤可提供粗糙棲地，也可能在洪水中浮起。木材自重與排水體積必須用同一含水狀態比較，部分浸水時不能使用完整體積計算浮力。淨上浮力只是錨定設計的一個分量，水流拖曳、撞擊與繞支點轉動可能控制接頭。木構隨浸泡吸水與腐朽改變密度，因此檢查不能只依新材出廠重量，還需辨認失去土體包覆後的受力路徑。~Wood and rootwads create rough habitat but may lift during floods. Compare weight and displaced volume at a consistent moisture state, and use submerged volume for partial immersion. Net uplift is only one anchorage load; drag, impact and rotation about supports may govern connections. Density changes through saturation and decay. Inspection therefore needs the evolving load path after surrounding soil erodes, rather than relying solely on the weight of freshly supplied timber.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rhow=1000 kg/m3; rhol=600 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=0.8 m3; Fu=(rhow-rhol)*g*V=3139.2 N。適用邊界：完全浸沒且密度均勻，僅計靜水淨上浮力，不是錨具額定需求。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rhow=1000 kg/m3; rhol=600 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=0.8 m3; Fu=(rhow-rhol)*g*V=3139.2 N. Applicable boundary: Fully submerged uniform density; calculates net hydrostatic uplift only, not an anchorage rating.
units.verify: 先量木構尺寸與濕重，再以部分浸水試驗檢查排水量。洪水後記錄轉角、接頭滑移與岸土流失，將浮力計算和現場受力方向比對，若受力不共線則增加力矩分析與接頭試驗。~Measure geometry and wet mass, then check displacement during partial immersion. After floods, record rotation, connection movement and soil loss. Compare the buoyancy direction with observed loading and add moment analysis when forces are not aligned.
units.failure: 岸土被淘空後木構可能繞剩餘錨點旋轉，接頭受撬力而非單純拉力。只用淨浮力除以錨點數，會掩蓋負荷分配不均及漸進破壞。~Erosion can leave timber rotating about one anchor, prying connections instead of loading them in simple tension. Dividing uplift equally among anchors hides unequal distribution and progressive connection failure.
units.misconception: 木構的淨浮力除以錨點數就是每支錨具唯一荷載~Net buoyancy divided by anchor count is the only load on each anchor
units.practice: 比較木材密度增加到八百公斤每立方公尺後的淨浮力，另畫一個岸趾淘空的偏心支承圖，指出還缺哪些尺寸才能計算錨點受力。~Recalculate uplift for timber density of eight hundred kilograms per cubic metre. Draw an eccentric support after toe erosion and identify the additional dimensions needed to resolve anchor forces and moments.

units.anchor: 岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量~Toe embedment and erosion allowance
units.title: 岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量~Toe embedment and erosion allowance
units.mechanism: 植生護岸常由岸趾流失開始失去支承，因此埋深應相對於可變河床而非單一施工測點。扣除一次量測沖刷深度能得到幾何餘量，但尚未考慮洪水規模、長期下切與橫向深槽遷移。埋得更深也可能增加施工擾動與地下水交換阻力。合理比較需要把施工基準、自然河床高程與預期變化分開記錄，再以重複測線判斷餘量如何消耗。~Vegetated protection often loses support when its toe erodes. Embedment must therefore reference a changing bed rather than one construction survey point. Subtracting observed scour gives geometric reserve but omits larger floods, long term incision and lateral thalweg migration. Greater embedment can also increase disturbance or obstruct groundwater exchange. Separate construction datum, natural bed elevation and expected change, then use repeated cross sections to track how the reserve is consumed over time.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：e=1.2 m; ds=0.5 m; er=e-ds=0.7 m。適用邊界：同一垂直基準的幾何差值，沒有將剩餘埋深換算成穩定安全係數。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: e=1.2 m; ds=0.5 m; er=e-ds=0.7 m. Applicable boundary: A geometric difference on one vertical datum, without converting remaining embedment into a stability factor.
units.verify: 在護岸前緣設固定測線並保留基準點，洪水前後用相同方法重測。將最大沖刷與回淤分列，避免以事後填回的河床掩蓋洪峰侵蝕，並檢查岸趾是否出現空洞或局部懸空。~Establish fixed transects and preserve survey benchmarks. Repeat measurements consistently before and after floods. Separate maximum scour from later deposition, because a refilled bed can conceal peak erosion; inspect for submerged voids or locally unsupported toe sections.
units.failure: 若深槽移到護岸外緣，先前測線可能漏掉局部淘空。表面仍貼合的護岸不代表底部有支承，需用水下測量確認邊界是否改變。~A migrating thalweg may create local undermining between previous transects. An apparently flush surface does not prove support underneath; underwater surveys must check whether the erosion boundary has shifted.
units.misconception: 剩餘埋深為正就代表護岸在所有洪水下都穩定~Any positive remaining embedment proves stability under every flood
units.practice: 假設第二次事件再降低河床三十公分，更新幾何餘量並說明為何仍無法宣布安全。規劃兩條新增測線以捕捉深槽側移，標出與舊基準的連結。~Lower the bed another thirty centimetres and update the reserve without declaring stability. Place two additional transects to detect lateral thalweg migration and show how they connect to the original survey datum.

units.anchor: 建立期植株存活率~Plant survival during establishment
units.title: 建立期植株存活率~Plant survival during establishment
units.mechanism: 生態護岸的功能會隨植物建立而演變，栽植後存活率只是其中一個可重複觀察的指標。萌芽、根系延伸與土壤覆蓋不同步，存活的插穗也可能尚未穿過潛在沖蝕面。調查應追蹤固定植株群並記錄洪水、乾旱與補植，避免把後來新增的植株混入原始分母。比較坡位與物種可找出適生限制，但不能由存活百分比直接推算抗剪強度。~Bioengineered protection evolves as plants establish, and survival is one repeatable indicator among several. Budding, root extension and soil cover develop at different rates; a living cutting may not yet cross an erosion plane. Track a fixed cohort and record floods, drought and replacements so newly planted individuals do not contaminate the original denominator. Compare species and bank elevations to investigate suitability, without converting survival percentage directly into shear resistance.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：N0=240 plants; Ns=180 plants; ps=Ns/N0=0.75 dimensionless。適用邊界：固定原始植株群的觀察比例，不含補植且不是抗剪能力比例。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: N0=240 plants; Ns=180 plants; ps=Ns/N0=0.75 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Observed proportion of the fixed original cohort, excluding replacements and not representing a shear strength ratio.
units.verify: 為原始植株編號，在相同季節重訪並明確定義存活，例如有活體芽或組織。另記失蹤、確認死亡及無法判定的數量，補植單獨建帳，再依坡位比較，避免淹水區漏查造成偏差。~Tag the original cohort and revisit in the same season with an explicit definition of survival. Record missing, confirmed dead and uncertain plants separately. Keep replacements in another register and compare bank elevations to detect incomplete field survey bias.
units.failure: 補植後若把新株計入存活數而沿用原始分母，會高估建立成功。另一方面，短期綠葉也可能掩蓋根部腐爛，需結合根區與土壤觀察。~Counting replacement plants against the original denominator exaggerates establishment success. Short lived foliage can also conceal root decay, so survival counts need observations of root conditions and surrounding soil.
units.misconception: 原始植株存活百分比就是護岸抗剪強度保留百分比~The surviving percentage of original plants equals the retained percentage of bank shear strength
units.practice: 將失蹤但未確認死亡的二十株分別視為存活及死亡，建立上下界。再設計一個不破壞整片護岸的根區抽樣方案，說明抽樣如何連結功能判讀。~Treat twenty missing plants alternately as alive and dead to construct bounds. Design a limited root-zone sampling programme and explain how those observations would connect survival records with the intended protective function.

units.anchor: 纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋~Mat overlap and effective coverage
units.title: 纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋~Mat overlap and effective coverage
units.mechanism: 椰纖維毯的採購面積不等於實際覆蓋面積，搭接、端部固定與曲面貼合都會消耗材料。搭接方向要配合水流，避免迎流邊緣掀起後使水在毯下集中。相鄰條帶需保持連續接觸土面，懸空會讓幼根難以穿入，也會形成沖蝕通道。數量估算可以先用平面幾何，但施工驗收還要檢查坡面展長、固定點與排水，不能用足量材料替代安裝品質。~Purchased coir mat area differs from effective cover because seams, end anchorage and surface conformity consume material. Orient overlaps with flow so exposed edges do not lift and channel water underneath. Adjacent strips need continuous soil contact; bridging can obstruct root establishment and create erosion pathways. Begin quantities with planar geometry, then inspect slope length, fixings and drainage. Delivering enough material does not demonstrate that the installation transfers loads or supports vegetation as intended.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2。適用邊界：平面平行條帶僅計五道縱向搭接，未扣端部與曲面裁切。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2. Applicable boundary: Parallel planar strips with five longitudinal overlaps only; excludes end anchorage and curved trimming.
units.verify: 在展開圖上逐條標出淨寬與搭接，不把每條兩側都重複扣除。現場用卷尺抽驗搭接和坡面貼合，灑少量清水觀察是否沿毯下集中，再另列端部埋設與修剪損耗。~Mark net width and seams strip by strip without subtracting every edge twice. Check overlap and soil contact in the field. A small controlled water application can reveal underflow; record end anchorage and trimming losses separately.
units.failure: 材料總面積足夠但接縫逆流或鬆弛時，水會掀毯並從下方沖走細土。裸露小縫可能擴大成集中溝，應追查接縫方向及固定點。~Adequate total material can still fail when loose or upstream-facing seams lift. Water then removes soil beneath the mat, turning small openings into channels; inspect seam orientation and fixing locations.
units.misconception: 採購總面積等於完工後不重疊的有效覆蓋面積~Purchased material area equals the effective nonoverlapping area after installation
units.practice: 把搭接改為三十公分重新計算淨覆蓋，並畫出彎曲岸坡需要裁切的位置。將幾何損耗與安裝缺失分成兩項，提出各自的驗收證據。~Increase overlap to thirty centimetres and recalculate effective coverage. Draw where a curved bank requires trimming, distinguish geometric waste from installation defects, and specify separate acceptance evidence for those two issues.

units.anchor: 退水期孔隙水壓~Pore pressure during drawdown
units.title: 退水期孔隙水壓~Pore pressure during drawdown
units.mechanism: 洪水退去後，河道側支承水壓可能先降低，而岸土內水位仍高，產生朝河道的滲流與較低有效應力。植物蒸散不能在短時間內保證消除這種壓差，根系補強也不取代排水條件分析。以水頭差估算孔壓只能描述指定位置與假定連通狀態，真實退水過程還受滲透係數、層理與儲水性控制。監測應把河水位與岸內孔壓時間序列同步對齊。~After a flood, river support pressure may fall before pore pressures inside the bank dissipate, promoting outward seepage and reducing effective stress. Plant transpiration cannot guarantee rapid relief, and roots do not replace drainage analysis. A head difference estimates pressure at a specified point under assumed connectivity, while actual drawdown depends on permeability, layering and storage. Synchronize river stage and internal piezometer records to distinguish transient pressure lag from static groundwater conditions.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa。適用邊界：同一高程兩點之靜水壓差示例，不求解非定常滲流或整體穩定。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa. Applicable boundary: Illustrates hydrostatic pressure difference at one elevation, without solving transient seepage or overall stability.
units.verify: 在岸內不同深度設孔壓量測點，與河水位使用同一高程及時鐘。退水時比較峰值與延遲，並查看排水出口是否阻塞；若土層反應差異大，應分層建模而非平均所有孔壓。~Place piezometers at different depths and use a common datum and clock with river stage. Compare pressure peaks and delays during drawdown, inspect drainage outlets, and model distinct layers separately when their measured pressure responses differ substantially.
units.failure: 不透水夾層可能保留高孔壓，岸面看似乾燥卻仍有深層滑動風險。若只量地表含水率，會誤判退水後已恢復承載能力。~A low permeability layer may retain pressure beneath a dry-looking surface. Surface moisture alone can therefore suggest recovered resistance while deeper parts of the bank remain vulnerable to sliding.
units.misconception: 岸面已經乾燥就代表深處孔隙水壓已完全消散~A dry bank surface proves that deeper pore water pressure has completely dissipated
units.practice: 假設河水再降五十公分而岸內水頭未變，重算壓差。畫出兩條可能的消散曲線，指出需要多長的觀測紀錄才能分辨快速與緩慢排水。~Lower river stage another fifty centimetres while holding internal head fixed and recalculate the pressure difference. Sketch fast and slow dissipation curves and specify monitoring duration needed to distinguish the two responses.

units.anchor: 泥砂通量的護岸檢核~Sediment flux around bank treatments
units.title: 泥砂通量的護岸檢核~Sediment flux around bank treatments
units.mechanism: 生態護岸可能攔截細砂，也可能在施工或洪水初期釋出土粒，因此應比較質量通量而非只比較濁度讀數。流量與濃度必須在相同控制體邊界及時段取得，清水側向流入會稀釋濃度卻不代表沉積。輸入減輸出得到的是控制體內暫存與未量側向交換的合計，需要另查床面變化才能歸因。濁度轉濃度關係還會隨粒徑與有機質改變，必須用水樣校準。~A treatment may trap fines or release soil during construction and early floods. Compare mass flux rather than turbidity alone, matching discharge and concentration at the same boundaries and times. Clear lateral inflow can dilute concentration without depositing sediment. Inflow minus outflow represents storage plus unmeasured exchanges, requiring bed observations before attribution. The turbidity to concentration relation also changes with grain size and organic material, so physical samples are needed for calibration.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qin=0.08 m3/s; Cin=0.12 kg/m3; Qout=0.075 m3/s; Cout=0.07 kg/m3; dt=3600 s; dM=(Qin*Cin-Qout*Cout)*dt=15.66 kg。適用邊界：一小時定常且無側向泥砂通量，所得為控制體暫存，不能直接宣稱永久去除。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qin=0.08 m3/s; Cin=0.12 kg/m3; Qout=0.075 m3/s; Cout=0.07 kg/m3; dt=3600 s; dM=(Qin*Cin-Qout*Cout)*dt=15.66 kg. Applicable boundary: Steady one-hour interval without lateral sediment flux; result is control-volume storage, not demonstrated permanent removal.
units.verify: 同步採集上下游流量與水樣，以實驗室懸浮固體建立濁度校正，再確認是否有排水溝或岸崩加入泥砂。用床面標記或沉積盤驗證暫存方向，並在下一次洪水後查是否重新被帶走。~Collect synchronized upstream and downstream discharge and samples, calibrate turbidity against suspended solids, and identify drains or bank failures adding sediment. Check storage direction with bed markers or traps, then inspect whether the next monitored flood event remobilizes that stored material.
units.failure: 若下游被清水稀釋，濃度下降可能被誤報成攔砂成功。漏算側向流量或採樣時間錯開，也會製造假質量差，應先閉合水量帳。~Dilution can make lower concentration appear to prove trapping. Missing lateral flows or mismatched sampling times also create false mass differences, so close the water balance before interpreting sediment retention.
units.misconception: 下游濃度下降就足以證明護岸永久移除了同等比例泥砂~Lower downstream concentration alone proves permanent removal of the same sediment fraction
units.practice: 新增一股已知流量與濃度的側向排水後重寫質量平衡，列出新增量測。比較暫存與永久去除需要的追蹤時間，說明下一場洪水可能如何改變結論。~Add a lateral drain with specified flow and concentration, rewrite the mass balance and list new measurements. Compare the monitoring needed for temporary storage and permanent removal, including how another flood could reverse the interpretation.

units.anchor: 對照監測的生態成效~Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring
units.title: 對照監測的生態成效~Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring
units.mechanism: 工程後植被增加可能來自較濕的年份、放牧減少或上游治理，而不完全由護岸措施造成。前後加對照的設計，用未處理區的同期間變化扣除共同背景，能提供比單純前後比較更清楚的證據。對照區仍須有相近坡位、土壤與管理，並避免受工程水流改變影響。覆蓋率是面積比例，差中之差應以百分點表示；它不能單獨代表物種多樣性、棲地品質或結構安全。~Vegetation can increase because a year is wetter, grazing declines or upstream management changes. A before-after comparison with an untreated reach subtracts shared background change and offers stronger evidence than a simple before-after count. The comparison reach still needs similar soils, elevation and management, without receiving the treatment's hydraulic effects. Cover is an area proportion, so the difference in differences uses percentage points and does not independently measure biodiversity, habitat quality or structural safety.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：T0=35 percent; T1=70 percent; C0=40 percent; C1=55 percent; effect=(T1-T0)-(C1-C0)=20 percentage-points。適用邊界：示範差中之差，因果解釋仍需平行趨勢與不受干擾的對照。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: T0=35 percent; T1=70 percent; C0=40 percent; C1=55 percent; effect=(T1-T0)-(C1-C0)=20 percentage-points. Applicable boundary: Illustrates difference in differences; causal interpretation still requires parallel trends and an unaffected comparison.
units.verify: 在工程前至少重複調查不同季節，確認兩區變化方向是否相近，之後用相同樣方與判讀規則追蹤。另記洪水、放牧與補植，若對照區也受到改流影響，應重新界定對照或限制因果結論。~Repeat surveys across seasons before treatment to compare trajectories, then retain the same quadrats and interpretation rules. Record floods, grazing and replanting. If altered flow affects the comparison reach, redefine it or limit the causal claim.
units.failure: 不同年份用不同樣方位置會把空間差異當成工程效果。若只選長得好的護岸段，平均覆蓋也會偏高，需事先固定抽樣設計。~Moving quadrats between years confuses spatial differences with treatment effects. Selecting only thriving sections further inflates average cover; fix the sampling design before observing which areas appear successful in the field.
units.misconception: 處理區植被增加的全部百分點都必然由護岸工程造成~Every percentage point of vegetation gain in the treated reach must be caused by the works
units.practice: 將對照區的後期覆蓋率改成百分之六十五，重算效果並解釋差異。設計一項獨立棲地指標，使覆蓋率改善不會被誤用為所有生態功能均改善的結論。~Change later comparison cover to sixty five percent, recompute the effect and explain the difference. Add an independent habitat indicator so increased cover cannot be mistaken for improvement in every ecological function.
